thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall with Boeing, UnitedHealth and Apple the biggest drags - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks fall with Boeing, UnitedHealth and Apple the biggest drags - MarketWatch
text: All 30 components of the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -2.03% are losing ground in morning trade Thursday, with just three of the components accounting for more than one-third of the Dow's 490-point loss , enough to push the blue-chip barometer into negative territory for the year. The biggest drag was Boeing Co.'s BA, -4.66% with the shares shedding 4.5%, and the $15.48 price decline subtracting about 105 points from the Dow's price. Next is UnitedHealth Group Inc. UNH, -2.88% with the shares down $7.29, or 2.6%, to shave about 49 points off the Dow; Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, -2.09% was the third biggest drag, as it fell $5.06, or 2.9%, to knock about 34 points off the Dow. The Dow has now slipped 0.6% year to date, while the S&P 500 SPX, -1.70% has lost 0.7% and the Nasdaq Composite COMP, -0.76% has gained 2.4%.
